nodes.label: Core Invariants
nodes.rationale: Player control is formation-level while soldiers are real simulated individuals; formations are a behavioral harness; ordered formations predictable, combat creates local disorder, breaking ranks trades order for freedom; reform requires disengagement; tactical outcomes must be understandable rather than dominated by invisible randomness.

nodes.label: Owner Play Mode Test Gate (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.source_location: Git, Versions, and the Test Gate
nodes.rationale: Never commit/push/merge/tag a gameplay change until the owner has manually tested it in Play Mode and explicitly approved; keeps main always playable and prevents untested agent work from landing.

nodes.label: Engineering Rules
nodes.rationale: Prototype before polish; smallest implementation that proves the gameplay thesis; no systems for hypothetical future needs; no morale, terrain, progression, multiplayer, or advanced enemy tactics without approval; verify behavior in Unity rather than assuming code works.

nodes.label: Codebase Knowledge Graph (graphify-out)
nodes.rationale: A prebuilt local knowledge graph of code and docs is queried before broad grepping so agents find system relationships cheaply; refreshed after substantial code changes.
